programme.title: National Finals Skijoring Race 2025
programme.desc: The Red Lodge Ski-Joring Association has been hosting the National Finals Ski-Joring Races since 1980. Ski-Joring originated in Scandinavian countries as a form of winter transportation.The west has transformed this into an action packed competition wherein teams of horse, rider and skier negotiate a 700+ foot course, the horse and rider taking a track to the inside of the course while the skier in tow, negotiates 20-some slalom gates and four jumps in hopes of completing two fast, clean runs. That isn’t so easy at speeds sometimes topping 25 mph.

programme.desc: A skate documentary following a 10-day tour across Thailand, featuring demos and premieres in several cities, capturing the energy of local skate scenes and the passion of skaters coming together to celebrate.

programme.title: Dalua Downhill
programme.desc: This is the journey of Douglas Rodrigues da Silva, aka “Dalua”, who is in search of the Downhill Skateboard world championship. This sport is among the most dangerous in the world where the skaters go downhill reaching speeds over 110 km/h. Over the course of two years, the film follows the Brazilian athlete in his travels around the world revealing that beyond the competition there is a story of determination, passion, pressure and pain. Friendship and rivalry awake some rowdy feelings between the athletes. It is this common bond between them that also what keeps them apart.

programme.title: En Route America

programme.title: En Route Departure
programme.desc: Follow Pep Fujas, Blake Nyman, Anthony Boronowski, Dylan Hood, Eric Pollard, Chris Benchetler and more as they chase storms from a Top Secret Military Mountain Warfare Facility, to the Italian Alps.

programme.title: Falling Angels
programme.desc: Three female BASE jumpers trek deep into the Venezuelan jungle to attempt a historic jump from the world’s highest waterfall, facing extreme terrain, technical challenges, and one of the most dangerous exits in the sport.

programme.title: Gunnie Season
programme.desc: An extreme skiing film featuring some of the world’s top professional skiers pushing their limits on snow and steep terrain.

programme.title: Peace and Left
programme.desc: A surf series following Hugues Oyarzabal, capturing spectacular first-person barrel footage at iconic spots around the globe, offering a rare inside view of high-performance surfing.

programme.title: Pour Vous Servir
programme.desc: Or At Your Service in English takes you to the heart of the action, and most of all makes you feel how riders and cameramen share the same emotions. Like a collection of short stories, the movie tells how they live together and share the joys and the hassles of the everyday, the trips, the exhaustion, the laughter...

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom 1 World Cup Ljubljana
programme.desc: Ljubljana is the chosen scenery for the Slalom World Cup. The slovenian capital will bring the top kayakers who will navigate the whitewater course passing through a series of combination of upstream and downstream gates. The fastest to achieve this will become the champion of the World Cup. Find out now what will happen in Ljubljana in the exciting Slalom World Cup!

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom 2 World Cup Pau
programme.desc: The Slalom World Cup series of 2020 continue in Pau. In the south of France, just 85km from the Spanish border, the kayakers will challenge themselves to this slalom competition. They want to become the best of the world in this Olympic discipline. Find out now who will be at the podium of the Slalom World Cup in Pau.

programme.title: Wind Masters - Episode 10: Baranja, PP Kopački rit, Osijek, Aljmaš, Vukovar, Slavonski Brod, Ilok.
Shifting Ice + Changing Tides
programme.desc: In March 2014 six women set sail from Iceland with the intention of sailing across the Denmark Strait and up the west coast of Greenland. Shifting Ice and Changing Tides' is a unique human and wind powered, female led, ski and sail expedition that is captivating for the beauty of its white, gelid landscape.In this remote, fascinating and beautiful region, six women will explore and ski first descents while limiting their environmental footprint by sailing and climbing. The expedition will serve as a platform for raising awareness about climate change and environmental issues as well as for inspiring and promoting female participation in snow sports adventures.Join them as they adventure in the wilderness to collect scientific data in one of the most incredible and deathly climates. This is their story.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 7 - Kornati – Dugi Otok
programme.desc: Kornati Islands are a National park and one of the most amazing creation of nature (or God) and sailing here is a real rest for heart and soul. Dugi Otok with its natural beauty, interesting places and amazing gastronomy is a real paradise for sailors.

programme.title: PRADA 36th America's Cup - The Last Call Documentary
programme.desc: The competition in the PRADA 36th America’s Cup has come to an end, but we cannot leave without a tribute. From the preparation for the PRADA Cup to the result in the 36th America's Cup Match find it all out.

programme.title: Wind Masters - Episode 10: Baranja, PP Kopački rit, Osijek, Aljmaš, Vukovar, Slavonski Brod, Ilok.
Shifting Ice + Changing Tides
programme.desc: In March 2014 six women set sail from Iceland with the intention of sailing across the Denmark Strait and up the west coast of Greenland. Shifting Ice and Changing Tides' is a unique human and wind powered, female led, ski and sail expedition that is captivating for the beauty of its white, gelid landscape.In this remote, fascinating and beautiful region, six women will explore and ski first descents while limiting their environmental footprint by sailing and climbing. The expedition will serve as a platform for raising awareness about climate change and environmental issues as well as for inspiring and promoting female participation in snow sports adventures.Join them as they adventure in the wilderness to collect scientific data in one of the most incredible and deathly climates. This is their story.

programme.title: The Portofino Classic
programme.desc: The SIAD Bombola D’Oro Trophy is a regatta organized by the Italian Yacht Club, and a classic event in Italy’s sailing season. Situated in the picturesque bay of Portofino, this vintage regatta is a classic spectacle that drives the attention of people across Europe.The Bombola D’Oro partly connects its success to its boat class: the Dingy 12’. Designed in 1913, this class has maintained its appeal and tradition despite the assaults from extreme technical novelties. In The Portofino Classic, we will visit the port and experience this unique regatta to get a taste of the sailing culture in Italy.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.9 - OPATIJA - IČIĆI - MOSĆENIČKA DRAGA
Sofia
programme.desc: Sofía is a short documentary film about the life of young surfer Sofía De Tomás, Canary Islands’ surf champion. Originally from La Orotava, Tenerife, Sofia tells us through interviews and cinematic shoots about her surfing lifestyle and what inclined her towards the surf world.Sofia balances her time between painting and surfing, and for her painting has a similar effect sometimes as surfing. However, for Sofia, surfing is a sport that traps you, and once you start it, you can’t stop, you want more. It’s something she can’t live without.Live the beauty of the Canary Islands in this short documentary film about this young talent in the surf world. Sofia offers beautiful scenery, heart-warming moments and a strong desire to get on a board yourself and start surfing the world.

programme.title: Sail For Surf
programme.desc: Collin Martins is a French chef with only one goal in mind: surfing. His passion started when he was just 3 years old. This was when his parents got him on a surfboard for the first time in Cap Ferret. It often starts like this. However, Collin’s course and his passion for surfing took a really atypical and unique turn.Looking for the best waves around the world, he decides to step into the unknown in 2017 and become autonomous living on a sailboat. From here he patiently studies the weather conditions, direction of the swell and tides to predict where the best waves will appear in order to surf them. Without any previous knowledge in the field, he carried out a professional training of marine navigation, bought a sailboat and took as headland Indonesia.Follow his exhilarating journey on his sailboat as he blends in Indonesian culture while catching the best waves.

programme.title: Inside Sailing - Episode 2
programme.desc: This time we will take you to the east coast of China, to the Fujian province and the island of Pingtan host to the third stop of Kitefoil world series. Staying in Kite Foiling we will then change continent and we will move to Gizzeria in Italy for the 2019 Kite Foil World Series.From Italy we head back to China and to the southwestern Guangdong Province, Yangjiang. This is the place where the 2019 “Nimble Cup” Asian Windsurfing Championship and the national Kiteboarding Championship took place. Finally, we will travel back to Europe and visit Palma for the fourth and final event of the Dragon European Cup circuit.

programme.title: IQFOiL International Games - Cádiz

Clipper: The Race Of Their Lives - Episode 5
programme.desc: In tonight's episode the Clipper Race fleet takes on the Asia Pacific Leg, split across two stages with spectacular destinations in China; crews celebrate the Chinese New Year at sea and swelter in the backing tropical heat; there's a second visit by King Neptune as father and son cross the equator and loved ones missed on Valentines Day.

programme.title: The Ocean Race - Leg 4 Newport - HL
Wind Masters - Episode 1: Dubrovnik, Mljet, Korčula
Surf's Cooking
programme.desc: Matt Bromley is a renowned big wave surfer. Ollie Swart is a chef. Together, the two best friends will embark on an adventure down Cape Town’s coastline. Foraging for food and looking for the best surf spots, Surf’s Cooking brings gastronomy to the surfing world with this beautiful friendship.Both friends will have to quickly adapt and learn about each other. For Matt Bromley, learning about foraging for food and how to cook it properly will become challenging, and Ollie Swart will have to surf past the obstacles in this nautical sport. Will they be ready to share their passion between them?Watch their adventure in South Africa on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Screen Heroes - Episode 5
programme.desc: Today we are in Ericeira in Portugal, Europe's first surfing reserve and a magnet for tourists and surfers from all over the world. While we enjoy the Portuguese sun before heading over to the festival, we leave you a preview of the first film: Otelo Burning, a South African drama that yields a different perspective from professional surfing. Let's dive in!

programme.title: Ocean Safari - Kenya - Episode 5
programme.desc: In this episode, Andi arrives to the ancient Arabic town of Lamu. She is about to discover what dhow culture means to the people of Kenya. She spends three days with the incredible Ali Lamu, dhow builder and carpenter who is trying to save the lost art of dhow building. A unique experience will reveal many secrets of the location and this traditional work that is getting lost amongst younger people.

programme.title: Surfer's Blood
programme.desc: Renowned surf photographer and filmmaker Patrick Trefz explores the essence of the sport he loves by profiling those who inspire him. Surfers' Blood tells the universal story of true individuals that share deep bloodlines connected to the sea.From wooden fishing boats in the Basque Country coast with oar and surfboard shaper Patxi Oliden to the metropolis of San Francisco and the eccentric computer shapes of Apple fame designer Thomas Meyerhoffer, unique people unite by a deep connection to the sea.Watch it on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Jump On Board - Episode 5
programme.desc: In this episode of Jump on Board, Cindy, Caitlin and Linda sail from Ithaca to Cephalonia, the largest of the Ionian Islands in Western Greece and home to our captain, Marcos. The girls get divided like the semi sweet water that runs throughout the island's caves - half sweet, half salt. In the end, it's Marcos who gets the largest dose of sweet from one of the ladies. Curious to see how it goes? Jump on board with us to find out!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 6 - Sibenik Islands - Murter
programme.desc: There are several interesting islands in the Sibenik area and we visited some of them. The island of Murter is known for its famous figs and delicacies from this healthy fruit. We will also show you some interesting places for swimming and sailing.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 7 - Kornati – Dugi Otok
programme.desc: Kornati Islands are a National park and one of the most amazing creation of nature (or God) and sailing here is a real rest for heart and soul. Dugi Otok with its natural beauty, interesting places and amazing gastronomy is a real paradise for sailors.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.9 - OPATIJA - IČIĆI - MOSĆENIČKA DRAGA
The Cyclades With Andi Van Zyl - Naxos Part 2
programme.desc: Over the past few days Andi has been travelling around Naxos, the largest of the Cyclades Islands in Greece. The Mediterranean waters look so inviting and so Andi cannot resist the opportunity to try a diving lesson on the island. We start our adventure at Blue Fin divers to get on the water. Dive into the second episode of The Cyclades with Andi Van Zyl, exclusive on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: The Road To Bermuda - Episode 6
programme.desc: In this episode we catch up on the results from the World Series in Oman, go on a sailing adventure on the Spirit of Bermuda and get a windsurfing lesson with Upwind Sports. We celebrate Good Friday Bermuda style, get VIP access to a new America’s Cup Exhibit, and catch up with the America’s Cup Endeavour Programme and the Red Bull Youth America’s Cup hopefuls!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 8 - Ugljan – Ist – Silba
programme.desc: The island of Ugljan, right across the town of Zadar, is known for its olives and olive produce. Beautiful sandy beaches and crystal clear sea will take your breath away. Smaller island of the Zadar archipelago like Ist and Silba looks like frozen in time and are really great for escaping from civilization.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 9 - Zadar Islands – Zadar
programme.desc: Small islands of Zadar archipelago are very popular for sailing and we will show you why. The town of Zadar was founded in Roman times and by every step through it you will stumble upon amazing heritage from the ancient times. Of course, we couldn't resist and we visited crazy funny Museum of Illusions.

programme.title: Centenary Yachts in St Tropez - Episode 1
Discovering Halki
programme.desc: In the south-eastern corner of the Aegean, west of Rhodes, there is a cosy island, a truly untouched gem of the Dodecanese. It’s a realm of rock and absolute peace; an island with great nautical tradition and proud islanders with an innate warmth.If you are looking for a hidden paradise on earth, then you have found the right place. Greece is home to a small island called Halki. Majestic and mystical; ethereal; elegant yet unpolished; and truly authentic.In this episode, we will visit Halki’s capital, Emborio and we will explore, with captain George, all the natural hidden treasures of the island.We are set to discover deep caves, bask on Trahia and Kania beach, and explore Alimia islet. We will visit an abandoned village, learning more about its rich history, and scuba dive down to the sea floor to get closer to a legendary shipwreck.Still untouched by mass tourism, Halki is the perfect destination for relaxing holidays away from the bright lights or for a quick getaway from the island of Rhodes. Watch Discovering Halki to become part of this almost untouched territory that is worth visiting.

programme.title: Surf The Alps - Zurich Wakeboard
programme.desc: Despite being nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps, Lake Zurich is home to a wealth of water sports.  Journalist Lucia Metzbauer wakeboards with Swiss pros, attends the annual match race, and even tries stand-up paddleboarding before discovering a little-known sport: kanupolo.Also, the International Wakeboard Competition of Züri Fäscht 2013 is taking place in the centre of Zurich, and athletes are ready for Switzerland's greatest freestyle competition in this class. Let's dive into it!

programme.title: Surf Ski - Episode 3 - Durban
programme.desc: Welcome to Durban! The Surf Ski World Tour is reaching its end, and standing at the pinnacle of the sport, the best open ocean paddlers from around the worlds reunite to take part in it. Jasper Mocké has proved to be in shape all season, but we have seen other important names raise to the top. Discover the exciting world of surf ski on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Sprint 1 World Cup Szeged
programme.desc: Szeged, the third biggest city in Hungary has been chosen once again for the International Canoe Federation Sprints World Cup. Athletes from all over the world are ready to prove their skills over the C2, K1, K2 categories. The event will prove to be hard as most of the athletes have been training for the Olympic Games.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Sprint 2 World Cup Barnaul
programme.desc: Barnaul, in Russia is a city to the west of the Ob River. This is one of the major rivers in Russia and home to the second stage of the Sprint World Cup. Despite the cold windy morning, more than 3000 people have assisted to watch athletes give their all in this competition.Watch the competition at Barnaul that concluded with the 5K challenge.

programme.title: Dusi Canoe Marathon - Episode 1
programme.desc: The three-day event of the FNB Dusi Canoe Marathon is back again for the 2016 edition. Participants competing for the podium will have to trust their partners, be the best at route scouting and keep their focus until the very last moment, a task that is not easy at all. Both mental and physical preparation play a crucial part in one of the toughest paddling competitions. Relive the best moments of the 2016 edition of the Dusi Canoe Marathon.

programme.title: Screen Heroes - Episode 6
programme.desc: Welcome back to Screen Heroes, the show that travels the globe and visits the most important surfing festivals in the world! We are in London, and before we find out more about the British surf scene we are going to check out the capital. Are you ready to see what London has in stock for us?

programme.title: Ocean Safari - South Africa - Episode 1
programme.desc: Welcome to Simon's Town, the neighbour port down here in Cape Town. Today on Ocean Safari we are meeting up with Roger Hudson and Asenathi Jim. This is the perfect representation of what the rainbow nation stands for. We will hear the story of these two individuals from completely different backgrounds join together to form a union and represent South Africa at the London Olympic Games. Let's find out more now on this first episode of Ocean Safari: South Africa!

programme.title: Sailing Deejay - Episode 1
programme.desc: Our DJ adventure is about to begin! Come with us as we pack our bags and leave for sunny Ibiza in Spain. After dropping our bags we are saying hi to David Guetta before trying out our skills as DJs and finding out how Ibiza's nightlife will surprise us. Join us!

programme.title: Sailing Deejay - Episode 2
programme.desc: Sailing Deejay continues its journey in Ibiza and the nearing islands to the rhythm of the night! Let's get the party started, on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: Maxiboat TV Show - Episode 1
programme.desc: For this first episode of Maxiboat, we focus on two original motorboats: the Foiler from the Enata shipyard (UAE), which flies on the sea thanks to foils, and the Tringaboat, an incredible French powerboat that can go on the road. Also in the summary, a test of the brand new Jeanneau 60 sailboat, an interview with the world tennis star Rafael Nadal aboard his Sunreef 80 motor yacht in Mallorca and a report on Bali catamarans shipyard.

programme.title: Jump On Board - Episode 6
programme.desc: This time, Caitlin, Cindy and Linda sail from Cephalonia to Zante, called by the Venetians, "The flower of the East." The girls will explore a secluded beach amidst white steep cliffs so surreal that it might as well be on Venus, not Greece. Will the crew begin to get sentimental now that the trip is coming to a close?

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.10 - RIJEKA - NOVI VINODOLSKI - NOVIGRAD
Colours Of Guadeloupe
programme.desc: Guadeloupe: the French overseas paradise in the southern Caribbean Sea. Clear blue waters, green vegetation and vibrant people bring out a whole rainbow of emotions in a limited island. Find out the true colours that wrap Guadeloupe with local guide Rudy as we dive into the cultural vibes of the country. From open markets to the local fishmongers and fishermen encircled by pelicans, Guadeloupe is full of secrets only locals know about. Rudy is determined to unveil them and share with us his passion for his beloved island while driving past the volcanic beaches that surround it.Get ready to meet local friends and hear their stories while discovering the Colours of Guadeloupe, now on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Discovering Karpathos - Part 1
programme.desc: We are set to visit the rich in tradition village of Olimpos and to swim in the clear waters of some of the most beautiful beaches in the Mediterranean. Then, we will discover some of the secrets by the seabed of the island and the creatures that inhabit them. This episode would not be complete without trying a watersport, so we will try to fly on to a kitesurf. Will you fly away with us?

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 10 - Mali Losinj - Opatija
programme.desc: In this episode we take you to the Mali Losinj on Losinj island and we will visit unique museum with only one but very important piece, enjoy delicious gastronomy and show you all the beauties of Mali Loinj. Opatija is known as a high-class tourist resort but we will explore some more interesting adrenaline and nature attractions.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 11 - Crikvenica – Novi Vinodolski
programme.desc: Crikvenica is known for its beautiful beaches and enjoyable holiday destinations for the whole family. We'll take you to some very interesting places and amaze you with healthy nature gastronomy. Novi Vinodolski is becoming nautical centre of the Northern Adriatic with 2 new marinas and in this episode we'll show you where to go, what to see and other places of interest.

programme.title: Postcards from Paros
programme.desc: Welcome to Paros, one of the islands in the Aegean Sea nestled between the Cyclades. Word spreads fast that Paros is one of the trendiest and most diverse islands in Greece, so we will be discovering more about this island’s history, culture and nautical destinations.Discover Paros flavours and visit the environmental and cultural part of Pars, protected for its indigenous fauna and flora, its positions in history and, of course, its marvellous beaches. Send Postcards from Paros, a pearl in the Aegean Sea worth discovering.

programme.title: Flavours Of The Sea - Episode 1
programme.desc: We arrive to the port to meet Chef Panos and invite him onboard to try a delicious recipe: linguine with shrimps. The Chef Panos will show us the Greek heritage in the food and a secret ingredient he uses to give his plates his own taste. Then, we go around the port to see whether if we can share this delicious platter with strangers. Then, we meet Chef Nikos to discover a special recipe he has for us.

programme.title: Sickline Extreme Kayak World Championship - Episode 1
programme.desc: 175 of the world's best kayakers are gathering for the 10th anniversary edition of the Sickline Extreme Kayak World Championship. They are committed to find the ideal or "sickest" line on this challenging competition. Racing up the creek, they are fighting for the world championship. Watch the best moments of the 2017 Adidas Sickline Extreme Kayak World Championship.

programme.title: Surf The Alps - Breaking Ice
programme.desc: Host Lucia Metzbauer meets the crazy athletes who brave sup-zero temperatures pursuing their love of nautical sport. The frigid Austrian Alps prove to be rife with nautical sport as Lucia goes racing with ice sailors, meets the 5x world record holder of Ice diving, and discovers the little known sport of underwater Ice hockey!

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Sprint 1 World Cup Poznan
programme.desc: Welcome to Poznan in Poland. We are at Lake Malta for the first ICF Canoe Sprint World Cup of 2019. For athletes, a hard winter's training has come to an end and they are ready to test themselves on the world stage to lay down a marker ahead of this season's big focus: the World Championships in Hungary. They are getting ready to race for their country at the 2020 Olympic Games in Tokyo. Who will be making an impact in this first event? Discover the best moments of the 2019 Canoe Sprint World Cup in Poland.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Sprint 2 World Cup Duisburg
programme.desc: We are in Duisburg, Germany, for the second ICF Canoe Sprint World Cup of 2019. Those who raced in Poznan last weekend had a big opportunity to lay down a marker and get the international respect, and now they have one more time to push themselves to the limit and improve their rankings before the World Championships in Hungary. Dive into the second leg of the 2019 Sprint World Cup, in Duisburg.

programme.title: Dusi Canoe Marathon - Episode 1
programme.desc: The 2017 edition of the FNB Dusi Canoe Marathon, raced over three days from Pietermaritzburg to Durban on the East Coast of South Africa is always tough paddling and portaging. With the country in the grips of the two year long drought, it became a whole lot tougher. Low rivers and searing hot weather, and the final stage raced on an empty river! Discover the best moments of the 65th Dusi Canoe Marathon.

programme.title: The Ocean Race - Leg 5 Aarhus - HL
Qatar Airways GKA Kite World Tour Magazines - Episode 8
Wind and Waves Gran Canaria
programme.desc: Welcome to Gran Canaria! This island in the Canary Islands is roughly 100 kilometres away from Morocco despite belonging to Spain, and the mix of cultures is palpable in the whole archipelago as visitors from all over the world come to enjoy its subtropical climate and optimal conditions for nautical sports.In this occasion, Lucia Metzbauer lands in Gran Canaria, host of the PWA World Championships. The high speed winds from Pozo Izquierdo drives the attention of athletes, so get ready to find out why this destination is one of the most attractive for windsurfing aficionados from around the world.Get on board in Wind and Waves Gran Canaria, a new adventure on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this first episode of 2017, we travel to the paradise beach of Pak Nam Pran, in southern Thailand for the first kite racing event of the year – the Asian Twin Tip Racing Championships. We also head south-east from Thailand to Indonesia, a country blessed with some of the best waves on the planet – and we meet up with pro kite wave surfers: Keahi de Aboitiz, Moona Whyte and Matt Elsasser. We visit another great place for kiting, Zanzibar, the pearl of the Indian Ocean, located east of Tanzania and from Zanzibar to Chile, to the big rocks of this incredibly wild coastline and consistently powerful waves. Finally, we move to Korea where the world’s top pro-riders faced off at the first round of the 2017 IKA Kitefoil Gold Cup.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode we fly to Europe and descend on Italy’s notorious Gizzeria kiteboarding spot, where the riders really like to be Uncool – in a statement of “reverse kudos”. Thanks to its reputation for excellent kiteboarding conditions and a relaxing ambience, Hangloose Beach annually hosts some of the world's top events. We catch up with the 2017 IKA TwinTip Racing Slalom European Championship where the titles are closely fought among a line-up of almost 120 riders from 21 different countries. In addition, multiple Champion Oliver Bridge is going to introduce us to the basics of kite control.

programme.desc: We are getting ready for the AC35 and we want to look deeper on this event. programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this first episode of 2017, we travel to the paradise beach of Pak Nam Pran, in southern Thailand for the first kite racing event of the year – the Asian Twin Tip Racing Championships. We also head south-east from Thailand to Indonesia, a country blessed with some of the best waves on the planet – and we meet up with pro kite wave surfers: Keahi de Aboitiz, Moona Whyte and Matt Elsasser. We visit another great place for kiting, Zanzibar, the pearl of the Indian Ocean, located east of Tanzania and from Zanzibar to Chile, to the big rocks of this incredibly wild coastline and consistently powerful waves. Finally, we move to Korea where the world’s top pro-riders faced off at the first round of the 2017 IKA Kitefoil Gold Cup.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode we fly to Europe and descend on Italy’s notorious Gizzeria kiteboarding spot, where the riders really like to be Uncool – in a statement of “reverse kudos”. Thanks to its reputation for excellent kiteboarding conditions and a relaxing ambience, Hangloose Beach annually hosts some of the world's top events. We catch up with the 2017 IKA TwinTip Racing Slalom European Championship where the titles are closely fought among a line-up of almost 120 riders from 21 different countries. In addition, multiple Champion Oliver Bridge is going to introduce us to the basics of kite control.

Also, there's an spectacular finish with the overall results going down to the wire.

The Ocean Race - Leg 6 The Hague - HL
Discovering Rhodes - Part 2
programme.desc: In this second episode, we will visit the historic and picturesque Mandraki Harbour before exploring the natural attractions of Butterfly Valley and Seven Springs. Rhodes is often known as the paradise island for windsurfers, so we will not miss the chance to see how it feels to be on a board out on the open water. Finally, we will visit the must-see archaeological sites that aren’t to be missed before leaving the island, the town and the Acropolis of Lindos.

programme.title: Un día en...Salón Internacional Náutico de Barcelona - Salón Internacional Barcelona - Ep1
Ocean Safari - South Africa - Episode 2
programme.desc: South Africa is home to some of the world's most legendary surfers. In this episode, Andi goes to Cape Town to catch Jordy Smith before the next leg of the ASP Tour. In Durban Andi meets with Bianca Buitendag, to find out how winning 6 star ASP events has changed her life. Then she spends time with the legendary artisan behind the sport: Spider Murphey.

programme.title: Sailing Deejay - Episode 3
programme.desc: Our aspiring DJs are learning all there is in the music industry and they cannot get enough of it! They are ready to apply what they have been learning these days, but are also eager to get into the water and do some sailing. Let's meet some more international DJs to find out a bit more about their music style.

programme.title: Sailing Deejay - Episode 4
programme.desc: The music scene in Ibiza is strong and passionate, and our aspiring deejays are grasping all the knowledge they can at the time they enjoy the day and night in the Spanish island. But, will this be enough to propel their career in the music industry forwards?Let's find out in this new episode of Sailing Deejay!

programme.title: Maxiboat TV Show - Episode 2
programme.desc: For this second episode of Maxiboat, we will discover a new French shipyard specialized in eco-responsible sailing catamarans: Windelo catamaran. Also, we will be updated on the construction of the Ultim racing multihulls, the giants of the seas that will participate in the next offshore races. Also on the agenda, sea trials on the BWA and Marshall range of rib boats.

programme.title: Jump On Board - Episode 7
programme.desc: In the last episode of Jump on Board, Linda, Caitlin and Cindy make the most out of their final days at sea with no more challenges and no more punishments. Linda shares her Japanese culture with the crew in an unforgettable night of sushi and sailing geishas. As the trip comes to a close, the girls get closer and even Linda and Blondie seem to be bonding. Will the finale lead to a tragedy or a celebration? Jump on board with us to find out!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 10 - Mali Losinj - Opatija
programme.desc: In this episode we take you to the Mali Losinj on Losinj island and we will visit unique museum with only one but very important piece, enjoy delicious gastronomy and show you all the beauties of Mali Loinj. Opatija is known as a high-class tourist resort but we will explore some more interesting adrenaline and nature attractions.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 11 - Crikvenica – Novi Vinodolski
programme.desc: Crikvenica is known for its beautiful beaches and enjoyable holiday destinations for the whole family. We'll take you to some very interesting places and amaze you with healthy nature gastronomy. Novi Vinodolski is becoming nautical centre of the Northern Adriatic with 2 new marinas and in this episode we'll show you where to go, what to see and other places of interest.

programme.title: What Sup - Episode 4

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this first episode of 2017, we travel to the paradise beach of Pak Nam Pran, in southern Thailand for the first kite racing event of the year – the Asian Twin Tip Racing Championships. We also head south-east from Thailand to Indonesia, a country blessed with some of the best waves on the planet – and we meet up with pro kite wave surfers: Keahi de Aboitiz, Moona Whyte and Matt Elsasser. We visit another great place for kiting, Zanzibar, the pearl of the Indian Ocean, located east of Tanzania and from Zanzibar to Chile, to the big rocks of this incredibly wild coastline and consistently powerful waves. Finally, we move to Korea where the world’s top pro-riders faced off at the first round of the 2017 IKA Kitefoil Gold Cup.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode we fly to Europe and descend on Italy’s notorious Gizzeria kiteboarding spot, where the riders really like to be Uncool – in a statement of “reverse kudos”. Thanks to its reputation for excellent kiteboarding conditions and a relaxing ambience, Hangloose Beach annually hosts some of the world's top events. We catch up with the 2017 IKA TwinTip Racing Slalom European Championship where the titles are closely fought among a line-up of almost 120 riders from 21 different countries. In addition, multiple Champion Oliver Bridge is going to introduce us to the basics of kite control.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Sprint 1 World Cup Poznan
programme.desc: Welcome to Poznan in Poland. We are at Lake Malta for the first ICF Canoe Sprint World Cup of 2019. For athletes, a hard winter's training has come to an end and they are ready to test themselves on the world stage to lay down a marker ahead of this season's big focus: the World Championships in Hungary. They are getting ready to race for their country at the 2020 Olympic Games in Tokyo. Who will be making an impact in this first event? Discover the best moments of the 2019 Canoe Sprint World Cup in Poland.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Sprint 2 World Cup Duisburg
programme.desc: We are in Duisburg, Germany, for the second ICF Canoe Sprint World Cup of 2019. Those who raced in Poznan last weekend had a big opportunity to lay down a marker and get the international respect, and now they have one more time to push themselves to the limit and improve their rankings before the World Championships in Hungary. Dive into the second leg of the 2019 Sprint World Cup, in Duisburg.

programme.title: Guadeloupe: Caribbean Blues
programme.desc: A visit to Guadeloupe is like visiting all corners of our world’s beauty. Looking to the left you can catch a breeze that swifts a kite surfer in the air, and to the right a gust of smoke from the Soufriere’s volcanic top. Everything in between is a perfectly balanced mixture of colour, tradition, and a lifestyle to die for.Guadeloupe: Caribbean Blues takes us on a trip to this dreamy destination. Rhythm and music go hand in hand in the Caribbean as different styles combine forming unique masterpieces that have us all dancing in no time. Get ready to dance to the sound of music, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Discovering Karpathos - Part 2
programme.desc: We take a stroll down the village of Arkansa, in the middle of Karpathos. The village is loved by tourists who have been coming for over 20 years. Then, we are going to explore some of the ruins of the island, starting in the north in the ancient Vrikous. The island is filled with Ancient Greek ruins we cannot miss on before boarding on a windsurf experience. With the Meltemi wind, Karpathos has become a windsurfing paradise.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 1
programme.desc: Welcome to the third season of Sail-Ho Croatia! We have already set sail around the most beautiful and interesting parts of the Croatian coastline, and this time we wanted to go a bit further! In this episode, we'll introduce you to the beauties of Cavtat and Konavle and will visit the unmissable treasure of the region: the pearl of the Adriatic, Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 2
programme.desc: In today's episode, we're taking you to the beautiful island of Korcula, a heaven for sailors in search for perfect bays, clear waters, exquisite wine and a mouthwatering local gastronomy. After visiting Korcula, we will pay a visit to an interesting small Dalmatian town that seems to be carved in a rock and was a known spot for notorious pirates.

programme.title: Endless Summer In Norfolk
programme.desc: Norfolk: population to just over 240,000 people and neighbour of the Chesapeake Bay is one of the top nautical destination for many enthusiasts in the USA. Holding a strong historical heritage and home to the largest naval base in the world, nautical sports are practiced regularly in this city in Virginia. Nautical Channel host Lucia Metzbauer heads to Virginia to discover Norfolk and what makes it so important in the nautical world. A port city on the Chesapeake Bay, bordering the Atlantic Ocean and countless rivers in its backyard, you just can't get away from the water. Discover some of the incredible 144 miles of coastline in the heart of Virginia with Lucia Metzbauer.Get ready to live an Endless Summer in Norfolk on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Flavours Of The Sea - Episode 2
programme.desc: In today's episode, we are meeting Chef Dimitri who has a special surprise prepared for us. He will join us on our boat to prepare a unique fish soup, and we are ready to share this delicacy with the people in the port. We will also be meeting Chef Kostas who has his own recipe for pasta with tuna. Come on board and try it out!

programme.title: Alpine Freestyle Kayaking
programme.desc: Graz, at the south of Austria, is a popular tourist destination as it has been recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Mur River is a defining feature of Graz. It runs through a total of four countries: Austria, Slovenia, Croatia and Hungary.Graz is also the home of Austria's number one Freestyle Kayaker Marcel Bloder. Together with him, we'll be exploring Graz and the Mur River and joining him on his journey to the 2013 ECA Freestyle Kayaking Euro Cup in Slovakia.Join Lucia Metzbauer in her new adventure in Graz in Alpine Freestyle Kayak.

programme.title: Surf The Alps - Munich
programme.desc: Munich, Germany, close to the Alps, but far away from the sea. In Munich, instead of waiting for vacations, surfers started experimenting on the 12m, 39ft wave in the Eisbach in the middle of the city 30 years ago.This way, river surfing was born. Nowadays, the wave is surfed day and night, during all seasons, attracting surf legends and tourists. But now the city wants to shut down the wave!

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Sprint 3 World Championships Szeged
programme.desc: Welcome to the Canoe Sprint World Championships 2019 celebrated in Szeged, Hungary! Today there are about 1,200 athletes racing from approximately 98 nations, meaning this is the biggest World Championships canoe sprint racing has ever seen. We're about to witness the fastest paddlers on the planet battle it out for medals, for World Championship glory, and to qualify for their country at the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games. Enjoy the best moments at Szeged on the 2019 Sprint World Championships.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Sprint 1 World Cup Szeged
programme.desc: Szeged in Hungary is the third biggest city in the country and the chosen scenery for the Sprints World Cup. Organisers of the ICF canoe sprint moved heaven and earth to prove an international event in the middle of a global pandemic was possible and safe for all participants. As a result, athletes took part in a splendid competition.

programme.title: The Smoke that Thunders
programme.desc: In 1855, the Scottish explorer David Livingstone named the Victoria Falls after his reigning queen. However, the Kalolo-Lozi people had their own name for it: Mosi-oa-Tunya, “the smoke that thunders”.Staring down into the depths of the mighty Zambezi River from the top of the world’s largest waterfall, the Victoria Falls, world-class divers Orlando Duque and Jonathan Paredes prepare for the most challenging dive of their lives.Be part of their adventure as they dive into the largest waterfall in the world in The Smoke that Thunders, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 1
programme.desc: Welcome to the third season of Sail-Ho Croatia! We have already set sail around the most beautiful and interesting parts of the Croatian coastline, and this time we wanted to go a bit further! In this episode, we'll introduce you to the beauties of Cavtat and Konavle and will visit the unmissable treasure of the region: the pearl of the Adriatic, Dubrovnik.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 2
programme.desc: In today's episode, we're taking you to the beautiful island of Korcula, a heaven for sailors in search for perfect bays, clear waters, exquisite wine and a mouthwatering local gastronomy. After visiting Korcula, we will pay a visit to an interesting small Dalmatian town that seems to be carved in a rock and was a known spot for notorious pirates.

programme.title: Discovering Rhodes - Part 2
programme.desc: In this second episode, we will visit the historic and picturesque Mandraki Harbour before exploring the natural attractions of Butterfly Valley and Seven Springs. Rhodes is often known as the paradise island for windsurfers, so we will not miss the chance to see how it feels to be on a board out on the open water. Finally, we will visit the must-see archaeological sites that aren’t to be missed before leaving the island, the town and the Acropolis of Lindos.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this first episode of 2017, we travel to the paradise beach of Pak Nam Pran, in southern Thailand for the first kite racing event of the year – the Asian Twin Tip Racing Championships. We also head south-east from Thailand to Indonesia, a country blessed with some of the best waves on the planet – and we meet up with pro kite wave surfers: Keahi de Aboitiz, Moona Whyte and Matt Elsasser. We visit another great place for kiting, Zanzibar, the pearl of the Indian Ocean, located east of Tanzania and from Zanzibar to Chile, to the big rocks of this incredibly wild coastline and consistently powerful waves. Finally, we move to Korea where the world’s top pro-riders faced off at the first round of the 2017 IKA Kitefoil Gold Cup.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode we fly to Europe and descend on Italy’s notorious Gizzeria kiteboarding spot, where the riders really like to be Uncool – in a statement of “reverse kudos”. Thanks to its reputation for excellent kiteboarding conditions and a relaxing ambience, Hangloose Beach annually hosts some of the world's top events. We catch up with the 2017 IKA TwinTip Racing Slalom European Championship where the titles are closely fought among a line-up of almost 120 riders from 21 different countries. In addition, multiple Champion Oliver Bridge is going to introduce us to the basics of kite control.

programme.title: Sailing Deejay - Episode 3
programme.desc: Our aspiring DJs are learning all there is in the music industry and they cannot get enough of it! They are ready to apply what they have been learning these days, but are also eager to get into the water and do some sailing. Let's meet some more international DJs to find out a bit more about their music style.

programme.title: Sailing Deejay - Episode 4
programme.desc: The music scene in Ibiza is strong and passionate, and our aspiring deejays are grasping all the knowledge they can at the time they enjoy the day and night in the Spanish island. But, will this be enough to propel their career in the music industry forwards?Let's find out in this new episode of Sailing Deejay!

Alacati Windsurf Mecca
programme.desc: Alacati is a town on Turkey’s Cesme Peninsula and for many a Windsurf Mecca. The town is famous for its constant winds and drives the attention of people who like practicing wind sports such as Windsurfing, Kitesurfing, SUP and many more. For years now, the small town is experiencing the impact of windsurfing in their economy, society and lifestyle as it attracts the attention of people worldwide that prefer the Turkish coast to practice water sports.Experience the Alacati Windsurf Mecca that will be sure to blow your mind on Nautical Channel.

programme.desc: Right after Weifang, some of the world's top riders flew to Pingtan for the 2017 IKA TwinTip World Championship, together with 2017 KiteFoil GoldCup - ACT3... and so did Kite Masters. Since then, thousands of new riders have joined this exciting sport in China.

programme.title: Eurosaf Championship Tavira
programme.desc: The EUROSAF (European Sailing Federation) Championship will take place in the waters off the Portuguese town of Tavira. The 19 sailing champions of Europe will be crowned in this gathering that has over 150 sailors and more than 100 boats and boards compete against triumph. 14 European countries have sent their best sailors to compete in eight different disciplines, including single-handed and double-handed dinghies, plus sailboards and high performance dinghy. They will compete over the 5-day competition to choose the youth champion of Europe in each of these disciplines. Follow the competition of the future talent of the sailing world as they sail across the waters of Tavira, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Inside Sailing - Episode 5
programme.desc: In this episode we start our sailing journey from Malaysia. The Road & Belt Royal Langkawi International Regatta is one of the most prestigious events on the islands. This year, Malaysia's award-winning marina, Royal Langkawi Yacht Club has welcomed thirty boats across seven different classes and more than a hundred sailors for the first Asian regatta in 2020.Then, we leave behind the exotic island of Langkawi to discover the most epic shots from the world of foiling. High speed and adrenaline combine to provide the most impressive moments, and we've picked our top ten.

programme.title: The World Sailing Show - Episode 1
programme.desc: The World Sailing Show is a close up monthly view of the racing world, a global sailing series featuring the very best action from the world of sailing.You can't miss it! This season is coming strong!

programme.title: America's Cup Insight - Episode 2
programme.desc: Welcome to another episode of America's Cup Insight. Today, we are at the heart of the British challenge inside the Land Rover B.A.R. We will discover more about the team, the players and the big family behind the boat. Also, find out how boundaries are changing the game and find out more about the wings of change.Plunge into the action with AC35 Insight.

programme.title: The Ocean Race - Leg 7 Genova - HL
Bart's Bash
programme.desc: The Bart’s Bash was created in an attempt to break the world record for the largest sailing race ever. Honouring America’s Cup great athlete Andrew “Bart” Simpson, this 24-hour race is compiled of thousands of sailors from over 60 countries set to take place at multiple ports. This fundraising race connects sailing communities across the globe and is sure to bring exciting competition all for a good cause. Sailing with a smile on their face, competitors rush across different venues raising money for the Andrew Simpson Foundation. The Foundations is driven by their belief that all young people should have the ability to excel and succeed in life and work, promoting health and well-being. Be part of this fundraising competition that yearly brings together thousands of people for a charitable cause.

programme.title: Maxiboat TV Show - Episode 3
programme.desc: Welcome to the third episode of Maxiboat. This month, we will be putting the brand new Beneteau GT45 to test. Then, French sailor Francois Gabart will show us his future offshore racing trimaran while we go for a quick tour around the Mer Concept shipyard in Concarneau. Finally, we shine on some highlights of the 2021 Jet Raid in Greece, the Dakar of the Seas or the longest jetski race in the world.

programme.title: Dis.Traction
programme.desc: The two-time world wave sailing champion Marcilio Browne, originally from Brazil, has decided to make the Hawaiian island of Maui his permanent home to pursue his passion. Dis.Traction follows Marcilio during his first training sessions leading into to the decisive season’s final contest where the greatest windsurfers compete for the ultimate prize.Following the end of contest season, Marcilio and fellow wave sailing champion Morgan Noireaux take to the mountains, or rather to the volcano for some alternative action. As the island is exposed to heavy ground swells from many directions, Marcilio and his friends are always looking for ideal spots to practice.Dis.Traction is a rollercoaster ride of action and an authentic insight into the perspective of a seasoned professional windsurfer. Shot on location it features the breathtaking beauty of the Hawaiian Island of Maui and showcases appearances of some of the sport’s greatest athletes.

programme.title: Bol D'Or: The Swiss Do It Better
programme.desc: The Bol D’Or Mirabaud is the most important inland lake regatta in the world. Taking place in Switzerland, a landlocked nation that sits on top of the sailing world with multiple successes whether in the Olympic, Offshore or in Grand Prix Racing formats, and champion of two America’s Cup victories. The race started in 1939 and it is a symbolic race that brings together the best of Switzerland’s sailing tradition.Every year they welcome mono-hulls and multihulls on Lake Geneva, starting in the city of Geneva. Enjoy the best moments at Szeged on the 2019 Sprint World Championships.

programme.title: Nautical Adventure In A Landlocked Country
programme.desc: Switzerland: home to the Alps and important water competitions like the Bol d’Or Mirabaud, the most important inland lake regatta in the world. Today it becomes the chosen scenario for this Nautical Adventure in a Landlocked Country. From extreme wakeboarding to canoe polo, we will discover that, despite being located far from the sea, Switzerland has a vibrant nautical scene.Get ready to accompany Nautical Channel’s host, Lucia Metzbauer, as she goes wakeboarding with local Swiss pros, learns about the annual Match Race regatta, tries her hand at Stand-Up-Paddle, and discovers the little known sport of Canoe Polo! This country has much to offer, so don’t miss out on its beautiful scenery that will have you pack your bags to come visit on the first occasion.Nautical Adventure in a Landlocked Country reminds us that water sports can be practiced even in countries that do not border the ocean. An inland fanta-sea for those nautical intrepids that are looking for ways of widening their horizons. Welcome to the Alps.

programme.title: Why Not Whitewater?
programme.desc: Welcome to Dimaro, the Rafting Center Val di Sole. Our story begins in 1982 when a group of adventurers decided to make history by being the first humans to raft down the River Noce. Not only they managed to go down the river against all odds, but they also fell in love with its beautiful landscapes and decided to share it with the rest of the world.Why Not Whitewater? takes us on a journey to the north of Italy to explore the valleys and rivers in the most adventurous ways. From canoening to kayaking and from rafting to hydrospeed, we are set to live an odyssey filled with adrenaline and fun that will leave you wondeing why not white water this summer!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 3
programme.desc: Welcome back sailors! In today's episode, we're taking you to one of the most beautiful Dalmatian islands - the island of Brac. Famous for its enchanting small towns that have kept an air of tradition, it also offers a taste of top class gastronomy and is recognized for its white stone that is used for buildings around Croatia and the world.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 4
programme.desc: Welcome to Vodice! This is one of the country's tourist centers known for its liveliness and variety of water sports. In this episode, we will be attending the Kornati regattas, exploring the beautiful Jezera on the island of Murter and much more. Come join us on Sail-Ho Croatia!

programme.title: Brilliant Corners Jamaica
programme.desc: The Caribbean is filled with places where tourism is rare or close to non-existent. However, there is so much potential for cultural and water sports tourism, they are called Brilliant corners. Nautical Channel is on a mission to explore the brilliant corners of the Caribbean.Going from Haiti all the way to Jamaica or Barbados, we will dive into these brilliant corners, many of them with no tourism at all. With a sustainable tourism approach, get ready to live a fully local experience on Brilliant Corners Jamaica while we practice water sports, taste the traditional local dishes and talk with the habitants of the area.On this occasion, we venture into Jamaica: the third-largest island of the Greater Antilles and Caribbean, home to famous personalities like Bob Marley or Usain Bolt. Through extreme surf travel and consequent writing and aestheticized by jazz, Sam Bleakley gives a voice to the brilliant corners of this country, revealing the character of the place by getting inside the mind of a coastline as much as people.Immerse yourself in the beauty of the yet to discover areas of the Caribbean, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Flavours Of The Sea - Episode 3
programme.desc: Chef Nikolaos is giving us a well-needed cooking lesson before jumping on board to prepare the recipe he has in store for us. He will also take the time to teach us how to find out whether if a fish is fresh or not before we go on and try the dish with the people from the port. Then, we are meeting with the young Chef Jason, who with only 19 years is the main chef at a 4-star hotel. He is cooking on board our boat, and we are excited to try out his dish.

programme.title: Rediscover North America
programme.desc: Six friends decide to cross 12 states on their canoe, embarking on the adventure of a lifetime. From the Gulf of Mexico to the Arctic Ocean, they battled against the current on the Mighty Mississippi, weathered ice and snow, crossed massive lakes, dodged shifting forest fires and shot challenging whitewater, all in a blasting total of 5200 miles. After eight long months, the expedition is ending, but with only 3 canoes, limited provisions and each other’s company along the way, will they be able to make it in one piece? Find it out on Nautical Channel. Awards: Best Adventure Travel Film – Reel Paddling Film Festival 2017. Winner Best Adventure Film – Waterwalker Film Festival 2017. Winner Canoe and Kayak Magazine’s 2016 Expedition of the Year Award.

Discovering Saint Maarten
programme.desc: One of the most captivating and curious islands of the entire Caribbean is without doubt Saint Maarten. The island is split into two nationalities while also hosting many more, becoming a hub of diverse excitement where the best of different cultures takes place. This is probably because the northern half of the island belongs to France while the southern side is part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, something highly uncommon around the world.Experience a 12-meter sailboat race, planes flying 50 overhead on crystal blue watered beaches, long streets filled with cultural fusion and wildlife tours and an underwater helmet-diving excursion by the side of a submarine wreck in Discovering Saint Maarten.Broadcasted on Nautical Channel.

Karujet 2017
programme.desc: The much awaited 20th edition of the Karujet has finally roared through the island of Guadeloupe. With the world's top guns of Jet Ski racing on the pitch, these daredevils ploughed through waves at speeds of up to 80 knots. Competition is rough as some participants break down and return to the beach with broken bones, others just give up, while the remaining brave riders fight to the end!The event takes place in no other than the festive and colorful Caribbean island, Guadeloupe. To bring this event to life, people from all over the world join to create what is becoming the biggest nautical event for Jet Ski lovers of the year.As competitors speed across the ocean, firm land spectators await in an exciting celebration. Who will become this year’s champion? Join Nautical channel as we follow the 20th edition of what might be the last Karujet.

programme.desc: Welcome to What SUP! On this week's episode we have the proclaimed Canadian singer-songwriter Royal Wood. But, singing won't save them from our paddleboard challenges, is he ready?

programme.title: Undercurrents
programme.desc: Undercurrents explores connection and compassion through the eyes of two female surfers as they share their motivation time after time to go back to the water despite cold waves, fears and little reward. Bringing in ideas from the Blue Mind movement and science of mindfulness, get ready to flow with the blue ocean as we explore the relationship with the sea to find out what happens when we pursue what we love.Arlene Maltman is one of first British & European female surfing champions. Natalie Fox is a Yogi, Surf instructor and marine activist. Throughout the film, they share their experiences and relationship with the sea.Neuroscientist & Mindfulness innovator Dr Tamara Russell & Blue Health Coach / Blue Mind Advocate, Lizzi Larbalestier provide expertise on how our minds and bodies are connected to the ocean and how this can have a benefit to our health and wellbeing.Awards:New Talent Award – Adventure Uncovered Film Festival 2020. Best Adventure Film – Shexreme Film Festival 2019.

Pounding surf, ideal beaches and warm raging water. This week on Facing Waves, we're paddling the Dominican Republic. Luke Hopkins takes his stand up paddleboard on an exploratory journey along the coast, through the rivers, and in the surf that surrounds this idyllic scenery. Come join us!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 3
programme.desc: Welcome back sailors! In today's episode, we're taking you to one of the most beautiful Dalmatian islands - the island of Brac. Famous for its enchanting small towns that have kept an air of tradition, it also offers a taste of top class gastronomy and is recognized for its white stone that is used for buildings around Croatia and the world.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 4
programme.desc: Welcome to Vodice! This is one of the country's tourist centers known for its liveliness and variety of water sports. In this episode, we will be attending the Kornati regattas, exploring the beautiful Jezera on the island of Murter and much more. Come join us on Sail-Ho Croatia!

programme.title: Sailing Deejay - Episode 5
programme.desc: Today we are going to visit the Hippie Market at Formentera, famous all over the world for its unique type of creativity. We will be making new friends that will be teaching us about their favourite music styles and, this close to the end, will our two protagonists be getting sentimental? Not without a mojito at the beach first! Let's dive in!

programme.title: Sailing Deejay - Episode 6
programme.desc: Our adventure is coming to an end, but the party never stops! Sam and Max have lived their adventure in Ibiza and Formentera, and have to get back home to show family and friends their new skills. We are sailing one last time and partying until dawn to make the most out of our time in Ibiza.

programme.title: America's Cup Insight - Episode 2
programme.desc: Welcome to another episode of America's Cup Insight. Today, we are at the heart of the British challenge inside the Land Rover B.A.R. We will discover more about the team, the players and the big family behind the boat. Also, find out how boundaries are changing the game and find out more about the wings of change.Plunge into the action with AC35 Insight.

programme.title: The Ocean Race - Leg 7 Genova - HL
What Sup - Episode 6
programme.desc: Welcome to What SUP! On this week's episode we have the proclaimed Canadian singer-songwriter Royal Wood. This band has been nominated for their Juno song as songwriter of the year by iTunes in 2008, and his music has been featured in shows slike Greys Anatomy or Private Practice. But, singing won't save them from our paddleboard challenges, is he ready?

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 5
programme.desc: First stop for this episode is the exotic destination and kiteboarding playground of Mauritius, for one of the most high-profile and biggest kite-foiling events: the Hydrofoil Pro Tour. From one island to another, we leave the exotic racetracks of Mauritius and head to Cagliari on Sardinia for another exciting gathering of the world's best kitefoiling riders. The World Championship also marked the close of the 2017 Kitefoil Gold Cup World Series.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 6
programme.desc: In this episode, we move to Dongshan, China for the 2017 Dongshan China International Kiteboarding Open. Combining culture with heritage, this small island, located along the Taiwan Strait, hosts a population of 200,000. The Youth Olympic Games is a hot topic in the Kiteboarding community, eagerly anticipated by riders and supporters. Reflecting an exciting and new race format, the slalom/boarder-cross is designed to challenge the riders' ability to stay in control, while maintaining maximum speed.

programme.title: Wind Masters - Episode 4: Skradin, Vodice, Tribunj
Discovering Saint Maarten
programme.desc: One of the most captivating and curious islands of the entire Caribbean is without doubt Saint Maarten. The island is split into two nationalities while also hosting many more, becoming a hub of diverse excitement where the best of different cultures takes place. This is probably because the northern half of the island belongs to France while the southern side is part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, something highly uncommon around the world.Experience a 12-meter sailboat race, planes flying 50 overhead on crystal blue watered beaches, long streets filled with cultural fusion and wildlife tours and an underwater helmet-diving excursion by the side of a submarine wreck in Discovering Saint Maarten.Broadcasted on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Iballa - Corazón de Escamas
programme.desc: After more than two decades in the world class of sports and overcoming different personal and sporting challenges of great significance, Iballa Ruano Moreno achieved in 2018 an historical landmark unprecedented in professional sports: winning the world championships in the same year the PWA World Circuit of Windsurf and the APP World Tour of Stand Up Paddle. This milestone never before achieved by an active athlete, highlights the level of dedication and improvement that the Moreno Twins and specifically Iballa Ruano, have been successfully reaping for so many years. However, the journey wasn’t easy. Corazón de Escamas is a short biographical documentary told in the first person and that shows the most intimate part of its history and is dedicated with great affection to the Ruano Moreno family. Dive into the world of this Canarian athlete and find out her inspiring story.

programme.title: Inside Sailing - Episode 6
programme.desc: In this episode, we take a look at how the how the COVID-19 pandemic has affected athletes and events around the planet. The GC32 Racing Tour has been fast to adapt and already started planning a future event. The GC32 Lagos Cup in Portugal has been moved to the end of August, the first stop in 2020.Later on, we take a look at how last season’s GC32 Racing Tour unfolded, witnessing some of the best scenes in the world of sailing.

programme.title: The World Sailing Show - Episode 2
programme.desc: The World Sailing Show is a close up monthly view of the racing world, a global sailing series featuring the very best action from the world of sailing.You can't miss it! This season is coming strong!

programme.title: SFT Surf Foil World Tour - Magazine Ep1
Barcolana 50
programme.desc: For all sea and sailing lovers and those who would never miss this one-of-a-kind show, the place is always the same every year: Trieste. Founded in 1969 thanks to the initiative of the yacht club Società Velica di Barcola e Grignano, the Barcolana competition has won its worldwide renown.This year’s 50th edition will be packed with surprises: more than 400 offshore and onshore activities, the opportunity to admire the vessel Nave Vespucci, the Barcolana 50 special postage stamp, and the Frecce Tricolori airshow just a few minutes before the start of the race. Stunningly huge yachts and sailboats steered by sailing enthusiasts will compete in the Regatta to mark this special edition of Barcolana 50.Follow this year’s competition of Barcolana 50: the international regatta that has won the Guinness World Record for the greatest sailing race.

programme.title: Wind Masters - Episode 5: Otoci Pašman i Ugljan
Sailing Fever In Annapolis
programme.desc: Welcome to Annapolis!Maryland’s capital city and located on Chesapeake, its historic district includes houses from the 18th century. Besides its historical interest, the city is one of the most exciting places to go to in the United States for nautical sports as yearly hundreds of enthusiasts come here for recreational or competitive races and regattas. Host Lucia Metzbauer heads to the Chesapeake Bay to discover what makes it one of the USA's top sailing destinations. Be part of an exciting regatta, visit the prestigious Yacht Club, meet the locals to enjoy steam crabs and work on your balance with Yoga on a Paddleboard – so many different things going on in this charming seaport. Join Lucia for a journey into American maritime history and an exclusive look at the famous 2014 Annapolis Spring Sailboat Show.

programme.title: Un día en...Salón Internacional Náutico de Barcelona - Salón Internacional Barcelona - Ep3
programme.desc: We invite you to discover and remember the best moments in "A day at the Barcelona International Boat Show".During the 4 days of the exhibition, you can discover more than 275 international exhibitors and almost 700 boats on the water, and many more boats at the show.

programme.title: Ocean Safari - South Africa - Episode 4
programme.desc: Andi van Zyl is back to Cape Town to meet up with two board riders. Tammy Robarts has just returned from the ISA World Surfing Games where she represented South Africa in stand up Paddleboarding. The winds in Cape Town have picked up and its time to meet with Luke Mc Gillewie, South Africa's top kite surfer.

programme.title: Escape to Zanzibar - Episode 1
programme.desc: As soon as we arrive on the island, we begin to explore Zanzibar starting in the northern part of the country. Nungwi, our chosen location is a common touristic destination and its guests are famously welcoming. Let's begin our journey by visiting the famous sea turtle conservation and protection center. Buckle up for this adventure!

programme.title: Escape to Zanzibar - Episode 2
programme.desc: We begin this day of discoveries with a visit to the most important historical landmarks in Stone Town. For lunch, we head straight on to The Rock: one of Zanzibar's greatest icons. The restaurant was literally built on a rock and can only be reached on foot during the low tide. Then, we will follow Shabed's suggestion and dive into the water to try all the activities available.

programme.title: Maxiboat TV Show - Episode 4
programme.desc: On the fourth episode of Maxiboat, we are back to the Monaco Energy Boat Challenge 2021 that gathered boats motored by alternative propulsion like hydrogen, electric motors and solar. Then we remember the best moments of the Super Yacht Cup in Palma. To finish off, we focus on an XXL Italian luxury rib Pirelli 35 and share the first images before the autumn boat shows of the X Power 33C, the first motor boat from the Danish shipyard X Yachts.

programme.title: Garrett McNamara & The Essence Of Big Wave
programme.desc: Garrett ‘GMAC’ McNamara is the American professional big wave surfer and extreme waterman known for breaking the world record for the largest wave ever surfed at Nazaré, Portugal. Surviving monstrous waves at Jaws, riding tsunamis from calving glaciers in Alaska and many more feats that are impossible to even imagine for many.Catch this exclusive half-hour special of Garrett McNamara & The Essence of Big Wave to understand his drive to get into the water despite knowing he’s risking his life. Find out more about his struggles, life-changing decisions, and the injuries that have made him become the legend he is today. From his earliest surfing days in Hawaii to world record success G-Mac tells it all.

programme.desc: For all sea and sailing lovers and those who would never miss this one-of-a-kind show, the place is always the same every year: Trieste. Founded in 1969 thanks to the initiative of the yacht club Società Velica di Barcola e Grignano, the Barcolana competition has won its worldwide renown.This year’s 50th edition will be packed with surprises: more than 400 offshore and onshore activities, the opportunity to admire the vessel Nave Vespucci, the Barcolana 50 special postage stamp, and the Frecce Tricolori airshow just a few minutes before the start of the race. Stunningly huge yachts and sailboats steered by sailing enthusiasts will compete in the Regatta to mark this special edition of Barcolana 50.Follow this year’s competition of Barcolana 50: the international regatta that has won the Guinness World Record for the greatest sailing race.

programme.title: Wind Masters - Episode 5: Otoci Pašman i Ugljan
Sailing Fever In Annapolis
programme.desc: Welcome to Annapolis!Maryland’s capital city and located on Chesapeake, its historic district includes houses from the 18th century. Besides its historical interest, the city is one of the most exciting places to go to in the United States for nautical sports as yearly hundreds of enthusiasts come here for recreational or competitive races and regattas. Host Lucia Metzbauer heads to the Chesapeake Bay to discover what makes it one of the USA's top sailing destinations. Be part of an exciting regatta, visit the prestigious Yacht Club, meet the locals to enjoy steam crabs and work on your balance with Yoga on a Paddleboard – so many different things going on in this charming seaport. Join Lucia for a journey into American maritime history and an exclusive look at the famous 2014 Annapolis Spring Sailboat Show.

programme.title: Escape to Zanzibar - Episode 1
programme.desc: As soon as we arrive on the island, we begin to explore Zanzibar starting in the northern part of the country. Nungwi, our chosen location is a common touristic destination and its guests are famously welcoming. Let's begin our journey by visiting the famous sea turtle conservation and protection center. Buckle up for this adventure!

programme.title: Escape to Zanzibar - Episode 2
programme.desc: We begin this day of discoveries with a visit to the most important historical landmarks in Stone Town. For lunch, we head straight on to The Rock: one of Zanzibar's greatest icons. The restaurant was literally built on a rock and can only be reached on foot during the low tide. Then, we will follow Shabed's suggestion and dive into the water to try all the activities available.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 3
programme.desc: Welcome back sailors! In today's episode, we're taking you to one of the most beautiful Dalmatian islands - the island of Brac. Famous for its enchanting small towns that have kept an air of tradition, it also offers a taste of top class gastronomy and is recognized for its white stone that is used for buildings around Croatia and the world.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 4
programme.desc: Welcome to Vodice! This is one of the country's tourist centers known for its liveliness and variety of water sports. In this episode, we will be attending the Kornati regattas, exploring the beautiful Jezera on the island of Murter and much more. Come join us on Sail-Ho Croatia!

programme.title: What Sup - Episode 6
programme.desc: Welcome to What SUP! On this week's episode we have the proclaimed Canadian singer-songwriter Royal Wood. This band has been nominated for their Juno song as songwriter of the year by iTunes in 2008, and his music has been featured in shows slike Greys Anatomy or Private Practice. But, singing won't save them from our paddleboard challenges, is he ready?

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 5
programme.desc: First stop for this episode is the exotic destination and kiteboarding playground of Mauritius, for one of the most high-profile and biggest kite-foiling events: the Hydrofoil Pro Tour. From one island to another, we leave the exotic racetracks of Mauritius and head to Cagliari on Sardinia for another exciting gathering of the world's best kitefoiling riders. The World Championship also marked the close of the 2017 Kitefoil Gold Cup World Series.

programme.title: Kite Masters - Episode 6
programme.desc: In this episode, we move to Dongshan, China for the 2017 Dongshan China International Kiteboarding Open. Combining culture with heritage, this small island, located along the Taiwan Strait, hosts a population of 200,000. The Youth Olympic Games is a hot topic in the Kiteboarding community, eagerly anticipated by riders and supporters. Reflecting an exciting and new race format, the slalom/boarder-cross is designed to challenge the riders' ability to stay in control, while maintaining maximum speed.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this first episode, we dive into the beauty of Wales: the first and only country to have a hiking trail around it's entire coastline. The Snowdonia National Park is a surfers and stand up paddlers paradise for the few who know about it. Stunning seascapes, ancient castles and perfect surf waves. This week on Facing Waves we're Paddling Wales with Dan and Heleen from Big Blue Adventures.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Episode 2
programme.desc: With 1000 miles of coastline and 250 miles of world class beaches, to many people the Dominican Republic is known as a tropical paradise. Pounding surf, ideal beaches and warm raging water. This week on Facing Waves, we're paddling the Dominican Republic. Luke Hopkins takes his stand up paddleboard on an exploratory journey along the coast, through the rivers, and in the surf that surrounds this idyllic scenery. Come join us!

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship - Episode 3 - GP of Vietnam - Binh Dinh
H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - Season Review - Ski Division & Ski Ladies
Iballa - Corazón de Escamas
programme.desc: After more than two decades in the world class of sports and overcoming different personal and sporting challenges of great significance, Iballa Ruano Moreno achieved in 2018 an historical landmark unprecedented in professional sports: winning the world championships in the same year the PWA World Circuit of Windsurf and the APP World Tour of Stand Up Paddle. This milestone never before achieved by an active athlete, highlights the level of dedication and improvement that the Moreno Twins and specifically Iballa Ruano, have been successfully reaping for so many years. However, the journey wasn’t easy. Corazón de Escamas is a short biographical documentary told in the first person and that shows the most intimate part of its history and is dedicated with great affection to the Ruano Moreno family. Dive into the world of this Canarian athlete and find out her inspiring story.
